subject: Request: pilot runway augmentation for Acme Robotics
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: additional runway & credits for Acme Robotics

Kim / Marissa —

Quick background: Acme hit the PLG free-credit limit faster than expected because their data ingest was delayed and they only started heavy inference this week. They’re mid-PoC on a robotics control use case that, if successful, could convert to a $480k ARR production contract in H2. Customer says they need an extra 4 weeks to finish integration and another ~50k free-token equivalent to complete evaluation tests.

What I tried so far: tightened evaluation scope, suggested throttling to keep within credits, and offered a discounted overage estimate — not enough; they say the timeline is the blocker. Deal desk flagged this as outside standard PLG policy and asked for exec signoff.

Ask: can we approve a one-time, nonstandard 4-week extension + 50,000 free-credit grant (token-equivalent) for Acme Robotics? I recommend adding a short success criteria and a signed ROI/acceptance note so we don’t set a wide precedent.

Attachments: Acme_POC_usage_20260614.csv (usage by day), Acme_Proof_of_Concept_SOW_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Dylan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask: additional runway & credits for Acme Robotics

Aditya —

Forwarding Dylan's note. TL;DR: strategic PoC (robotics controls) with high probability of expansion; customer stalled on integration. Dylan recommends a 4-week runway + 50k free-credit one-off. Deal desk says nonstandard so needs exec approval.

My assessment: low net cash cost for Redwood (they’re well-instrumented, usage spike is recent), high upside if we get production. Suggested constraints if you’re open to this: 1) tie credits to explicit success criteria (latency + error reduction targets), 2) require a signed letter (email is fine) acknowledging this is a one-time exception, 3) shorten the extension if they don’t show progress at 2 weeks.

Can you weigh in? If you want, I can draft the customer note.

-Kim
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: additional runway & credits for Acme Robotics

Thanks for the context. A couple of clarifying items before I can approve:
1) Concrete success criteria — what are the acceptance metrics the customer will sign up to?
2) Is there any regulatory/data-residency exposure with the extended run?
3) Can we get a brief acceptance note (email ok) where Acme confirms they understand this is a one-time exception and will not request recurring credits?
4) Proposed fallback: if no progress in 2 weeks, credits stop.

If answers are satisfactory I’m inclined to approve the 4-week runway + 50k-token-equivalent, capped to the PoC project (no cross-account usage). Also want to tag this as an exec-approved exception in Deal Desk notes (will author a short memo).

- Aditya
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: additional runway & credits for Acme Robotics

Aditya —

Answers inline:
1) Success criteria: (a) sustained control-loop inference at >1000 calls/hour with p95 latency <120ms for at least 48 hours, and (b) 10% reduction in failure-rate (per their baseline) on live test scenario. Acme agrees to provide test logs and a 1-page acceptance email if we hit targets.
2) Data residency: all test traffic is in us-west-2; no regulated customer data involved. They use simulated sensor feeds.
3) I’ve asked Sylvia to send an acceptance email. She’s agreed verbally.
4) Fallback: agree to 2-week progress check and stop credits if no progress.

I’ve attached the latest usage CSV and the PoC SOW. If that meets your ask, can we get the one-off signoff today? Sylvia is hoping to resume by Wed.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: additional runway & credits for Acme Robotics

Approved (one-time exception): 4-week extension + 50,000 token-equivalent credit, limited to the Acme Robotics PoC project. Conditions:
- Must receive a one-paragraph acceptance note from Acme (Sylvia or Jordan) that acknowledges this is a one-time exception and confirms the success criteria.
- Credits will be applied only to the project environment; deal desk will set consumption guardrails.
- Two-week progress checkpoint; if no measurable progress, credits are rescinded.

Kim, Dylan — I’ll log this in Deal Desk and issue an internal exception memo. Please get the acceptance email from Acme and I’ll route the credits.

-Aditya
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Roberts <sylvia.roberts@acme.ai>, Jordan Meyer <jordan.meyer@acme.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway: Redwood one-time credits decision (Acme Robotics)

Sylvia / Jordan —

Good news: we’ve approved a one-time, nonstandard 4-week extension and 50,000 token-equivalent credit for the Acme Robotics PoC. Conditions:
- You confirm in a single reply that you accept the success criteria below and acknowledge this is a one-time exception: p95 latency <120ms sustained for 48h at >1000 calls/hour AND 10% reduction in failure-rate versus your baseline.
- We will review progress at the 2-week mark and reserve the right to pause credits if no measurable progress is shown.
- Credits apply only to the PoC project environment named in the attached SOW.

If you can reply to this email confirming the acceptance language, we’ll route the credits immediately and kick the extension into effect.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
